name: log-viewer
title: LogViewer
description: Log lines as they arrive (container and pod logs, a Compose project's merged logs): appended through a ref with no React state per line, at most maxLines kept, virtualized rows, ANSI SGR colours and bold, italic and underline on the terminal.* roles, stdout and stderr marked, timestamps, follow, wrap, and search with Mod+F.
usage: Use LogViewer for output that keeps coming: a container's or pod's logs, a build, a Compose project's services merged by time (streamColumn with a chart category per service). Lines never go through props: call ref.append(lines) as they arrive (each { ts?, stream?, text }, text with ANSI escapes as the process wrote them) and ref.clear() for a new run. Keep follow in the app's toolbar with onFollowChange: scrolling up stops following, scrolling back to the end or the footer's Follow resumes it. Give onDownload to offer the loaded lines as a file (the app saves it). Mod+F, F3 and Shift+F3 search the loaded lines; ref.openSearch() opens the bar from a button. Use Terminal for an interactive session, CodeBlock for a fixed snippet, JsonViewer for structured data.

props.name: ref
props.description: append(lines), clear(), lines(), text() (the loaded lines as text), openSearch(), scrollToEnd().

props.name: maxLines
props.description: At most this many lines are kept; the oldest are dropped in chunks of a tenth, and the footer counts them.

props.name: follow
props.description: Keep the newest line in view (controlled); scrolling up turns it off through onFollowChange.

props.name: defaultFollow
props.description: Follow at first, when follow is not controlled.

props.name: onFollowChange
props.description: Called when scrolling, End or the footer's Follow changes following.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Long lines wrap (each rendered row is measured) instead of scrolling sideways.

props.name: timestamps
props.description: Shows each line's ts in a column.

props.name: formatTimestamp
props.description: How a timestamp is shown; formatLogTimestamp (UTC to the millisecond) by default.

props.name: streamColors
props.description: The colour marking each stream at the start of its rows: neutral, danger, warning, success, info or cat-1 to cat-8.

props.name: streamColumn
props.description: Shows each line's stream in a column with its colour's swatch (a project's services).

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Shows a Download button in the footer; called with the loaded lines as text.

props.name: overscan
props.description: Rows rendered beyond the viewport on each side.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own; set the height here.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The frame in terminal.bg; data-slot="log-viewer", data-follow while following.

slots.name: search
slots.description: role="search": the query, the match count (aria-live), Previous, Next and Close; data-slot="log-viewer-search".

slots.name: scroller
slots.description: role="log", the scroll container and the tab stop; data-slot="log-viewer-scroller".

slots.name: row
slots.description: One line: the timestamp, the stream and the text; data-slot="log-viewer-row", data-stream, data-wrap, data-current (the current match's line).

slots.name: footer
slots.description: The line count (and how many were dropped), Follow while not following, Download; data-slot="log-viewer-footer".

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus on the scroller: Fluent's double ring (focusRing).

accessibility: The lines are role="log" with aria-live="off" (a busy log would flood a screen reader) and an accessible name; the scroller is the tab stop, so arrows, Page Up and Page Down scroll it and End follows again.
Mod+F opens a search bar (role="search") whose count is announced politely; Enter and F3 go to the next match, Shift with them to the previous one, Escape closes it and returns focus to the log.
Colour is never the only mark: stderr rows also carry data-stream, the stream column names the stream, and every ANSI colour reads at 4.5:1 on terminal.bg (the token build checks each pair).
Focus shows the double ring: ring.width in color.ring around ring.inner-width in color.ring-inner.
